overview.description: A React single-page app talks to one Fastify process that owns a single SQLite file; chosen because a neighbourhood library has one small server and no need for a hosted database.

data-flow.flow: Sign-in form -> session route -> signed cookie -> loan routes
data-flow.description: Every loan route calls requireSession first, so a request without a live session never reaches the database.

conventions.naming: camelCase for functions, PascalCase for types
conventions.file-organization: one route file per resource under src/server/routes
conventions.imports: relative paths inside a package, no path aliases

component:SessionStore.responsibility: Creates, checks and ends signed-in sessions

component:Catalogue.responsibility: Browse tools by shed and category

security.passwords: Hashed with a per-member salt; the first sign-in forces a change
security.exports: A steward role is required for the loan export
